id: # Starter rows for a Flutter or Dart repo.

args: parser=exitcode -- { {{files}} | tr "\0" "\n" | grep -E '\.dart$' || true; } | xargs -r dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed > /dev/null
why: changed Dart files are formatted, so diffs stay readable
the app has no analyzer error on any pushed commit
the widget and unit tests pass on every pushed commit
a merge-conflict marker left in a file breaks it for every reader
the gate configuration is changed by a human only, so an agent cannot loosen the gate that judges it
